props.name: label
props.description: What the code is — "Booking reference", "Order number". Shown above the code and used to name the copy button.

props.name: value
props.description: The code itself, copied exactly as given.

props.name: copyable
props.description: Show the copy button. Default true.

props.name: size
props.description: `lg` for a code that is the point of the screen (a confirmation); `md` (default) inside details.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: Visible text of the copy button. Default "Copy".

props.name: copiedMessage
props.description: Announced and shown after a successful copy. Default "Copied".

props.name: copyFailedMessage
props.description: Announced and shown when the clipboard is unavailable or refused.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called with the value after it reached the clipboard.
